title: New Update Available (v1.0.4+25)
message: Multi-select PDF Class Selector, new page per class in Results List PDF, and Teacher Add & Login fixes.
releaseNotes:
• Multi-select Class Selector (All Classes or 1+ classes) for Results List PDF & Bulk Marksheets PDF
• Every class starts on a new page in Results List PDF with class-wise totals & pass rate
• PDF options moved cleanly into AppBar 3-dot menu
• Fixed Teacher Add (allowedClasses saving & multi-email sync) and Teacher Login directory lookup
